    let unit_y = cast int(Math.floor(at_y)) & 255
    let unit_z = cast int(Math.floor(at_z)) & 255

    let y = at_y - Math.floor(at_y)
    let z = at_z - Math.floor(at_z)

    let u = fade(x)
    let v = fade(y)
    let w = fade(z)

    let a = p[unit_x] + unit_y
    let aa = p[a] + unit_z
    let ab = p[a + 1] + unit_z

    let b = p[unit_x + 1] + unit_y
    let ba = p[b] + unit_z
    let bb = p[b + 1] + unit_z

    let near =
        lerp(v,
             lerp(u, grad(p[aa], x, y, z), grad(p[ba], x - 1.0, y, z)),
             lerp(u,
                  grad(p[ab], x, y - 1.0, z),
                  grad(p[bb], x - 1.0, y - 1.0, z)))

    let far =
        lerp(v,
             lerp(u,
                  grad(p[aa + 1], x, y, z - 1.0),
                  grad(p[ba + 1], x - 1.0, y, z - 1.0)),
             lerp(u,
                  grad(p[ab + 1], x, y - 1.0, z - 1.0),
                  grad(p[bb + 1], x - 1.0, y - 1.0, z - 1.0)))

    return lerp(w, near, far)
